Episodes.Title: Welcome to Versailles
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, André Jacquemetton
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: King Louis XIV of France begins preparations of transitioning his fathers hunting lodge into a grand palace he envisioned.

Episodes.Title: I Am the State
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Marie-Thérèse gives birth to a child, but it's not the King's. Philippe wants to join the fight against the Spaniards. Montcourt is humiliated by King Louis.

Episodes.Title: Mirror for Princes
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: King Louis wishes for the nobility to live at his side in Versailles, so long as they have proof of their nobility. An emissary from Africa appears at Versailles. Cassel recruits Montcourt.

Episodes.Title: The Road
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Highwaymen, led by Montcourt, wind up killing friends of King Louis, including his goddaughter. Fabian is tasked with bringing the killers to justice. Philippe triumphs at Cambrai.

Episodes.Title: Bow to Your King
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Sasha Hails
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Philippe returns to Versailles a war hero. Louis holds a celebration, while losing confidence in Fabian due to the constant highway robberies that are impeding the funding of his palace. Cassel refuses to attend the celebration.

Episodes.Title: Invalides
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Sasha Hails
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: The construction workers at Versailles are on strike. Cassel moves to Versailles after his home is burned. Louis falls ill.

Episodes.Title: Revelations
Episodes.Writer: Sasha Hails, Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Louis experiences hallucinations. The Chevalier is arrested. Montcourt continues the robberies in order to fund the conspirators plot against the King. Some of the nobles want Philippe to take Louis's place as king.

Episodes.Title: Diplomacy
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Andrew Bampfield
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Henriette suffers a miscarriage, but Louis wants her to visit her brother in England for an alliance against the Dutch. The Chevalier, destined for the gallows, is freed. Montcourt foils an assassination just to be reinstated.

Episodes.Title: Etiquette
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Andrew Bampfield
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Louis gives Philippe a tedious task that the Chevalier helps him with. Rohan makes his true intentions known. Fabian arrests and punishes Béatrice. Henriette succeeds in the diplomacy in England.

Episodes.Title: Bring the Garden Here
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Duchess Henriette becomes suddenly ill when she returns from a visit to her brother in England. They fear she might have been poisoned, so King Louis XIV shuts all access To Versailles.
